text:
Naveen Raj: Quick follow-up from the GPU capacity postmortem. Need owners + tiny validation plan for autoscale/quota fixes. Keep replies 1-2 lines.
Olivia Park: I can own the scheduler tuning PR and the canary automation.
Samir Desai: I will handle quota backstop + finance ask.
Mei Chen: I can run the replay validation and post a short results table.
Devon (ops-bot): Created task AS-1300: "gpu-capacity-action-sprint" assigned to Olivia, Samir, Mei. Due 2024-12-10. Link: https://redwood.internal/ops/tasks/AS-1300
Lucas Price: For detection heuristics, propose adding a 30m ramp detector: trigger if token_rate increases >12% over 30m AND avg_gpu_util > 72%.
Hannah Lee: I’ll own the 90-day recurring-pattern scan. ETA 4 business days.
Olivia Park: Scheduler plan (short): node_min_util=0.2, add 30s smoothing, reduce scale-down aggressiveness. Will include canary (5%) + rollback snippet in PR. Smoke command: `./tools/smoke_autoscale --nodes 3 --ramp 600`.
Samir Desai: Quota plan: 10% burst buffer with hard cap + 20m cooldown. Drafting finance request now; adding cost projection for 48h worst-case.
Mei Chen: Validation plan: staging 2h slow-ramp then 30m burst. I’ll post CSV with columns: seed,qps,p95,avg_gpu_util,cache_hit (<= 10 rows). ETA Tue.
Naveen Raj: Action items: Olivia - scheduler PR + canary + rollback steps - due 2024-12-06; Samir - quota proposal + finance ticket - due 2024-12-05; Mei - staging validation + CSV - due 2024-12-04; Hannah - 90-day pattern analysis - due 2024-12-09; Naveen - 1-page playbook - due 2024-12-07.
Devon (ops-bot): AS-1300 status: 5 actions recorded, 3 owners assigned, finance pending. Next reminder scheduled 2024-12-02 10:00 UTC.
Olivia Park: I’ll add `kubectl rollout undo <deployment>` snippet and a quick health-check script in the PR.
Samir Desai: Adding `gpu_pool` and `workload_tag` to autoscale alerts so finance can slice spend per pool.
Mei Chen: Will include `gpu_pool` column in validation CSV.
Naveen Raj: Constraint: all infra changes must run a 10m canary with auto-rollback if error rate >1% or p95 latency increases >20% vs baseline.
Hannah Lee: If I find a recurring slow-ramp signature I’ll propose a headroom multiplier for sessions >30m.
Naveen Raj: Thanks. Update AS-1300 and ping this thread with blockers. :thumbsup:
